text: Can you pull together every site on Marrow Agrisupply you can find across #central-team? List each with where it comes from. Need it before the customer call.
reply_text:
I've sent Pree the list in our DM, as a reply to her message. #central-team only has 16 messages and I read all of them. It turned up three Marrow Agrisupply sites:

1. Eastbank: Hollis, 9 Jun 2026, in the new-store escalation. Ticket PD-4821 has the store's door import, but the file labels doors E1/E2 while the booking sheet uses 01/02.
2. Pine Crossing: Pree, 9 Jun 2026, same escalation. The morning receiver's screen only shows the afternoon shift.
3. Wichita store: Pree, 2 Jul 2025, mentioning a check-in with the Wichita store dispatcher. This one is likely rather than confirmed, because the message doesn't name the account. I'm counting it as Marrow Agrisupply only because Tobias had just said her Zoom was hosting their office hours.

I also told her that no full store list was ever posted in the channel. Enid, Salina and Kearney show up as Marrow Agrisupply sites in other Central team notes. I left them out because she asked about #central-team, and offered to pull them if she wants. Before reading the channel I checked that she's a member, and I didn't use `search_messages` or anything else she can't see.
